2123225756847259883.en_summary: Brian Sullivan argues that AI is here to stay but will make humans more valuable, not less. Original individual thoughts and ideas will outperform uniform AI-generated ones, as bosses will spot AI ideas easily. Travel agents are making a comeback.
2123225756847259883.zh_summary: Brian Sullivan 認為人工智能雖然會持續存在，但會讓人類更有價值，而非更少。原創的個人想法和理念將勝過千篇一律的人工智能生成內容，因為老闆很容易識別人工智能想法。旅行社正在復興。

2123225671518634171.en_summary: Mark Yusko notes that in 2013 one Bitcoin could buy two copies of GTA V, and tomorrow one Bitcoin could buy 786 copies of GTA VI, though he is unsure one would want to buy even one.
2123225671518634171.zh_summary: Mark Yusko 指出，2013 年一枚比特幣可以購買兩份 GTA V，明天一枚比特幣可以購買 786 份 GTA VI，不過他不確定是否會想購買哪怕一份。

2123225640983781741.en_summary: Tracy Shuchart replies to @dferris1961 and @JoshYoung that she addressed this on Monday.
2123225640983781741.zh_summary: Tracy Shuchart 回覆 @dferris1961 和 @JoshYoung 說她星期一已處理此事。

2123225465762542044.en_summary: Greg Brockman posts about ChatGPT for all things accounting, quoting OpenAI's announcement of a new Accounting plugin and partner plugins for tasks like month-end reports, bank reconciliation, data entry, and audit prep, integrating with tools like QuickBooks, Xero, NetSuite.
2123225465762542044.zh_summary: Greg Brockman 發布關於會計方面的 ChatGPT，引用 OpenAI 宣布的新會計插件和合作夥伴插件，用於月末報告、銀行對賬、數據輸入和審計準備等任務，並與 QuickBooks、Xero、NetSuite 等工具整合。

2123225057287692346.en_summary: Raging Capital Ventures enjoyed a podcast with short seller @John_Hempton, noting lots of wisdom and great contrarian takes.
2123225057287692346.zh_summary: Raging Capital Ventures 享受了與賣空者 @John_Hempton 的播客，指出其中有很多智慧和出色的反向觀點。
